clock_model.rtl_boundary: clk_i rising edge advances one complete normalized E-cycle when clock_enable_i is high
clock_model.historical_boundary: HD6303R derives E from its oscillator and defines memory/peripheral activity relative to E
clock_model.limitation: This normalized boundary omits pin subphases; hd6303r-four-subphase-device-bus defines the separate active-cycle pin wrapper and its reset/electrical exclusions

signals.name: clk_i
signals.fact: one rising edge advances one normalized E-cycle

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: low preserves synchronous CPU and peripheral state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active-low reset latches the configured legal operating mode and begins an external reset-vector fetch

signals.name: standby_n_i
signals.fact: active low and accepted at an enabled E boundary; suppresses external transactions and output enables while retained RAM remains supplied

signals.name: standby_power_ok_i
signals.fact: digital validity indication only; no analog threshold is modeled

signals.name: nmi_n_i
signals.fact: active-low non-maskable interrupt

signals.name: irq1_n_i
signals.fact: active-low highest-priority maskable external interrupt

signals.name: port1_i
signals.fact: physical GPIO levels returned by PORT1 reads where that register exists

signals.name: port1_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch in Modes 2/4 and the low eight address bits in Mode 1

signals.name: port1_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO DDR in Modes 2/4 and all ones for the Mode-1 lower-address bus outside reset/standby

signals.name: port2_i
signals.fact: GPIO, timer-capture, SCI-clock, and SCI-receive input levels

signals.name: port2_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch with timer and SCI overrides

signals.name: port2_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO direction with documented timer and SCI overrides

signals.name: external_data_i
signals.historical: Port-3 or dedicated external data input
signals.fact: normalized external read byte

signals.name: external_address_o
signals.fact: full sixteen-bit CPU address without half-cycle multiplexing

signals.name: external_data_o
signals.historical: Port-3 or dedicated external write data
signals.fact: CPU write byte

signals.name: external_write_o
signals.fact: one denotes a CPU write; qualify it with external_bus_valid_o

signals.name: external_bus_valid_o
signals.fact: selected external transaction in every legal Mode 1, 2, or 4 configuration

signals.name: external_opcode_fetch_o
signals.fact: qualified external read that fetches an opcode

signals.name: sci_tx_o
signals.fact: normalized asynchronous serial transmit level

signals.name: sci_clock_o
signals.fact: normalized internal serial clock output for a supported selection

halt_interrupt_behavior: HD6303R has no HALT input; SLP stops CPU execution while peripherals continue, enabled requests vector, masked requests resume at the following instruction, and STBY instead enters reset-state operation before an external reset-vector restart

locators: HD6303R notice and HD6301V1 sections 2.1-2.4 and 2.12, tables 2-1-1 and 2-2-1, printed pages 126-145 and 162-166
